webhooks.detail: Atlas sends alert notifications as HTTP POST to project webhook URL (X-MMS-Event alert.open/close/update/acknowledge/cancel/inform, optional HMAC secret via X-MMS-Signature). Alert events only, not general resource events.

evidence.quote: You can configure Atlas to send alert notifications to a webhook endpoint as HTTP (HyperText Transport Protocol) POST requests for programmatic processing.

sandbox.detail: Free clusters (formerly M0) never expire; can be created via UI, CLI or Admin API. Subset of features.

evidence.quote: Free clusters never expire, and provide access to a [subset](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/free-shared-limitations.md#std-label-atlas-free-tier) of Atlas features and functionality.

rate_limits.summary: Token bucket per endpoint set and scope (org/project/user/IP); 429 RATE_LIMITED_TOKEN_BUCKET with Retry-After; limits vary per endpoint, queryable via rateLimits API, may change without notice

evidence.quote: Atlas uses the Token Bucket Algorithm to limit the number of requests it processes.
A Go SDK for the [MongoDB Atlas API](https://docs.atlas.mongodb.com/api/).
This repository hosts the OpenAPI specification for the [Atlas Administration API (v2.0)](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/api-resources-spec/v2/).
